title: Personalized LLM Recommendation with Semantic IDs: Autoregressive Beam Search vs. Multi-Token Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.15864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale personalization is shifting from embedding-table retrieval to LLM-based recommenders that generate the Semantic ID (SID) of the item to recommend, where each SID is a short sequence of discrete hierarchical content codes. A single instruction-tuned model can then unify retrieval, content understanding, and language, and recommend brand-new titles from their content alone using SID; then, how should the model generate the SID? Traditionally, models rely on a single language modeling head that generates tokens autoregressively, typically using constrained beam search. In contrast, an emerging body of work explores multi-token prediction (MTP), where dedicated heads predict all tokens in parallel, substantially reducing the decoding latency associated with beam search. translated_title: 基于语义ID的个性化LLM推荐：自回归束搜索与多词元预测的对比
translated_abstract: 大规模个性化推荐正在从嵌入表检索转向基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统，这类系统通过生成推荐物品的语义ID（SID）来完成推荐，其中每个SID是由离散的分层内容编码组成的短序列。一个经过指令微调的单一模型可以统一检索、内容理解与语言能力，并仅凭内容本身就能通过SID推荐全新的条目；那么，模型应该如何生成SID呢？传统上，模型依赖单一的语言建模头以自回归方式生成词元，通常采用受限束搜索。相比之下，新兴的研究探索了多词元预测（MTP），即使用专用的预测头并行预测所有词元，从而大幅降低束搜索带来的解码延迟。我们报告了一项工业规模的、公平对等的两种生成范式对比研究：单头自回归解码与MTP。我们引入了一种新的辅助……
tldr: 本文在工业级规模上对基于语义ID（SID）的LLM推荐系统中两种SID生成范式——单头自回归束搜索与并行多词元预测（MTP）——进行了公平的对等比较，以评估二者在推荐效果与解码延迟之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an industry-scale, apples-to-apples comparison between single-head autoregressive beam search and multi-token prediction (MTP) for generating Semantic IDs in personalized LLM-based recommendation.
